title: Search private PDFs on an ordinary laptop
summary: Start with text extraction and full-text search; add OCR or embeddings only when the collection needs them.

title: Stop Chinese text becoming one giant RAG chunk
summary: Check whitespace assumptions, bound chunk length, and keep each passage tied to its original source offsets.

title: Keep one study fact and all its sources
summary: Deduplicate cards across textbook chapters and lecture transcripts without losing the evidence or review history.

title: Diagnose GitHub MCP authentication in Docker
summary: Separate sandbox secrets, CLI login state, and MCP configuration before changing credentials.

title: Fix a LaTeX redline that will not compile
summary: Treat the redline as its own build: preserve both baselines, reproduce the toolchain, and inspect the first failure.

title: Reproduce research code on a new workstation
summary: Pin a revision, check one input and output contract, and keep enough evidence to explain what worked or failed.
